derivation: Re-aggregation of existing NRQ-006/NRQ-007 artifacts only. No model forward pass, no new training, no new data generation was executed to produce this manifest.

registry.cell_definition: 60 classes x 4 bundle seeds (1,2,3,4) x 5 data seeds (101-105)

cross_check_35_vs_41.note: Task instruction: cross-check the 60-class/1200-cell base, the mean-threshold 35 failure classes, and the all-cell-gate 41 failure classes; record the 6-class difference as unclassified if not already classified, without conflating it with the existing 35-class causal-attribution registry.
cross_check_35_vs_41.derivation_method: Direct re-aggregation of the 1200 raw per-cell records in docs/research/NRQ006_REVIEW_RECORD.json['records']: all_cell_pass(class) = all(cell.oracle_em >= 0.85 and cell.exhaustive_functional_em >= 0.95 for cell in the class's 20 cells); diff = {classes failing all_cell_pass} - {classes in NRQ006_REVIEW_RECORD.json['failure_classes'] (the 35 mean-threshold failures)}.
cross_check_35_vs_41.formal_attribution_status_rationale: NRQ-007's stepwise causal attribution (3-arm intervention: continuous/diagnostic-reset/standalone) was executed only over 'all 35 failure recipes' (STEPWISE_CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_NRQ007.md section 2.1); these 6 classes pass the mean-level floor and were therefore never inputs to that procedure. This manifest does not run a new causal attribution for them.

descriptive_observation_not_a_new_causal.failing_cells_concentration: 5 of 6 classes have every failing cell on bundle_seed=4 (the 6th, NEGATE->SHIFT->SHIFT, has 2/7 failing cells on bundle_seed=2, the rest on bundle_seed=4)
descriptive_observation_not_a_new_causal.cross_reference: Consistent with NRQ-007 section 3.2's already-attributed 'Chained Shifts' subset of BUNDLE_SPECIFIC_COMPONENT_FAILURE ('Bundle 4 exhibits slight degradation in SHIFT accuracy... causing 3-step chained shifts to drop below the 0.95 threshold on Bundle 4') and with NRQ-008/ADR-0168's independently measured Bundle 4 oracle EM of 0.9147 (< the 0.95 per-cell floor) on an unrelated cell, both of which independently document a weaker Bundle-4 SHIFT/attention substrate. This is offered as a plausible, pre-existing explanation, not a new formally-attributed conclusion.

target_panel.name: SHORT_SEQUENCE_CAPACITY_DEFICIT_SORT_AFTER_SELECT
target_panel.membership_source: NRQ-007 section 3.2.1 (STEPWISE_CAUSAL_ATTRIBUTION_NRQ007.md) and NRQ007_REVIEW_RECORD.json class_attributions, filtered on final_attribution == 'SHORT_SEQUENCE_CAPACITY_DEFICIT'
target_panel.derivation_of_sort_input_length_set: SelectOp.output_length(L) = max(1, L // 2) applied to the training-exposure length range L in {6,7,8,9,10} (src/apc/environments/operations.py SelectOp; src/apc/evaluation/unified_oracle_causal_benchmark.py UnifiedBenchmarkConfig.sequence_length_range default (6,10)) yields {3,3,4,4,5} = {3,4,5}. Not assumed; derived from the operation's own output_length function.

standalone_length_adequate.description: SORT executed standalone on its original training-exposure length domain L in {6,7,8,9,10}, i.i.d. sampled exactly as in the historical training/eval generator.
standalone_length_adequate.pre_repair_reference: Baseline SORT correct_exact_match on this domain from the unified oracle causal benchmark's own historical acceptance criterion (>= 0.95, unified_oracle_causal_benchmark.py:905) and per-bundle NRQ-006/007 evidence (e.g. NEGATE->SORT->BIND/SELECT/SHIFT and SORT->REVERSE->*/SORT->SHIFT->*/SORT->SELECT->BIND classes, all length-adequate, mean_oracle_em >= 0.988).

composition_length_adequate_sort_classes.description: Depth-3 composition classes containing SORT at a length-adequate position (not step 1 or step 2 of SELECT), currently passing the strict all-cell gate (20/20 cells). Used to verify the repair does not regress SORT's already-adequate composition behavior.

non_sort_capability_canary.description: Classes not containing SORT at all, currently passing the strict all-cell gate (20/20 cells). Used to verify Core / other-primitive / router / scorer invariance during the SORT-only repair (non_target_parameter_updates == 0 proxy check at the behavioral level).

causal_control_panel.note: SORT has no required_argument_names (src/apc/environments/operations.py SortOp), so the applicable causal-control triple is Correct / Wrong-family / None -- there is no Wrong-argument arm for SORT (matches the task's literal wording, which names Correct/Wrong-family/None, not Wrong-argument, for this primitive).
causal_control_panel.existing_mechanism_reused: src/apc/evaluation/unified_oracle_causal_benchmark.py lines 883-908 (parameter-free branch of the acceptance-criteria loop). Not reimplemented; reused as-is.

correct.definition: prim(h) with prim = SORT's own CrossPositionPrimitive, argument_provider=None

wrong_family.definition: WRONG_FAMILY_MAP['SORT'] = 'NEGATE'; evaluate NEGATE's primitive on the same input, score against SORT's correct target
wrong_family.symbolic_reference: NegateOp.apply == tuple(vocab_size - 1 - t for t in sequence)

none.definition: SORT's own primitive with prim.enabled = False, which returns all-zero logits (src/apc/primitives/primitive.py: 'if not self.enabled: return content_features.new_zeros(...)'), i.e. argmax predicts token 0 at every position
none.symbolic_reference: constant-zero sequence of the correct output length

coincidence_exclusion_rules: Exclude any evaluation example where sorted(seq) == seq (input already sorted) from the None-arm causal-sensitivity computation, since the all-zero None output could coincidentally equal the correct output only if seq is the all-zero sequence -- registered as a general exclusion rule, not a per-example post-hoc filter chosen after seeing outputs.
Exclude any evaluation example where sorted(seq) == negate(seq) (vocab_size - 1 - t applied elementwise equals a sorted permutation of seq) from the Wrong-family-arm causal-sensitivity computation.
causal_control_panel.extension_beyond_existing_benchmark: The existing unified_oracle_causal_benchmark.py causal-control evaluation only exercises sequence_length_range=(6,10). This pilot registers the identical Correct/Wrong-family/None procedure additionally at L in {3,4,5} (the target panel's reachable intermediate length set) as part of the repair pilot's evaluation, not as a new methodology.
